title: Forms of Energy
summary: Light, chemical, electrical, kinetic, thermal, sound and stored energy, and how devices change one form into another.

ib.note: Energy stores and transfers are formalised in MYP 4–5

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 7: Work, Energy and Simple Machines (forms of energy, conservation of mechanical energy)

objectives: I can name and give examples of different forms of energy.
I can describe energy transformations in everyday devices using energy chains.
I can state that energy is conserved, and explain where 'wasted' energy goes.
misconceptions: Energy gets used up and disappears.
A device can give out more energy than it takes in.
